cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my interest in the WordPress Developer position. With a strong foundation in web development and hands-on experience building and maintaining WordPress sites, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your team.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I am responsible for building and maintaining client websites using WordPress, Elementor, and the Astra theme. I have developed a workflow that ensures responsive, SEO-friendly, and secure sites. My work involves customizing themes, implementing plugins, and troubleshooting issues promptly. I collaborate closely with designers and marketers to turn concepts into functional websites that meet client goals.

One of my proudest achievements is mirook.com, a WordPress site I designed and built for a Belgian youth chess champion. This project allowed me to apply my skills in custom theme development, structured data (JSON-LD), and technical SEO audits. I implemented schema markup, optimized for speed and SEO, and ensured cross-device compatibility. The site's search-health score improved measurably, demonstrating my ability to deliver results.

I am proficient in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and PHP, and I stay current with WordPress best practices and trends. My background includes front-end development for a healthcare web application, where I honed my problem-solving skills. I am also familiar with security best practices, including regular updates and backups.

I am a collaborative communicator, comfortable working with cross-functional teams. I am eager to bring my technical expertise and creative problem-solving to your team. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to your projects.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok

Baver Ok
Digital Marketing · SEO · GEO · Content · Web
Zwijndrecht, Belgium | +32 470 42 48 36 | baverok@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok

## Profile
Junior web developer with a technical foundation in WordPress, SEO, and web design. At Episto, I build and maintain client websites in WordPress using Elementor and the Astra theme, and implement on-page SEO and keyword-targeted content. On my own project (mirook.com) I've applied structured data, entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. Comfortable across content management, social media coordination, and performance reporting; quick to pick up new tools and platforms, and growing into analytics, e-commerce content management, and campaign support. Based in Zwijndrecht, next to Antwerp. Works in English and Turkish; Dutch: B1, currently taking classes to improve further.

## Core Skills
- WordPress Development: custom theme/plugin development, page builders (Elementor), Astra theme, responsive design
- Web Technologies: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, PHP, AngularJS
- SEO & GEO: on-page SEO, technical SEO audits, structured data / JSON-LD schema, entity optimization, GEO & AEO (AI search visibility)
- Content & CMS: SEO blog & content writing, editorial content publishing, website content management
- Optimization & Security: site speed optimization, security best practices, backups, migrations
- Analytics & Reporting: Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Ads
- Social: social media content & integration
- Languages: English (professional), Turkish (native), Dutch (B1)

- Track site performance with SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and Google Ads to guide SEO and content decisions

### Warehouse & Logistics — Katoen Natie (Antwerp), 2025–2026
- Maintained accuracy and efficiency in a high-volume, fast-paced logistics environment

### Front-End Developer — ViviDoctor (Belgium), 2018–2019

## Projects

- Implemented structured data (JSON-LD schema, including SportsEvent and FAQPage), entity/knowledge-graph markup, and an llms.txt file to improve visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines (GEO/AEO)
- Ran iterative technical SEO/GEO audits, measurably raising the site's overall search-health score
